sessions.name: Monday, MAP
sessions.intent: Maximal aerobic power. Whatever you do in round one you must match or beat in round four. If round four is worse, round one was too hard.
sessions.note: Loads are light on purpose. Wall ball 6/4kg to 10m, farmers carry 2x20 / 2x12.5kg, step-up bodyweight 45 to 50cm. If a floor movement forces a stop it is too heavy. No sled on Monday: it corrupts the MAP intent and the track is the wrong end of the room.

lines.text: 3 min on your round 1 machine, RPE 3 building to 5
Flow x2: world's greatest stretch 4/side, band pull-apart 10, air squat 10, scap pull 8, leg swing 10/side
Touch each floor movement once: 5 burpee broad jumps, 10 light wall balls, 10 step-ups, 20m carry
Priming ramp on your round 1 machine

circuit.heading: 4 rounds: 4 min work, 3 min rest

circuit.restAfter: Rest 3 minutes between rounds. Final rest not taken

lines.text: 4 min easy machine, RPE 3. Nobody sits down
2 rounds: 12 band pull-apart, 10 band pull-over, 10/side side plank reach, 20s dead hang

sessions.name: Friday, threshold
sessions.intent: Threshold. Three blocks of eight minutes with no stopping inside the eight. RPE 7 is three or four words at a time, no more and no less.
sessions.note: Zones: 1 runner + 15m shuttle, 2 runner + wall ball, 3 rower + farmers carry, 4 bike + bench step-up, 5 ski + sled. Your pod stays in one zone for the whole block. Zone 5 is capped at three people, one sled lane each, so nobody ever waits. If a floor load makes you stop it is wrong: tell the coach.

lines.text: 4 min on your starting machine, RPE 3 building to 5
Mobility: 8/side 90/90 hip switch, 10/side ankle rocker, 8/side open book, 10 band pull-apart, 10 glute bridge
Threshold calibration, coach corrects on the floor

circuit.restAfter: Rest 3 minutes between blocks. Final rest not taken

Cool down: 2 min easy walk, then calf and soleus, adductor, lat

sessions.intent: Same session as last Monday with one extra round. The pace does not change. Round five puts you back on your round one machine, so it is a direct comparison.
sessions.note: Week 1 round 1 numbers go on the board next to each name before class. Wall ball 6/4kg to 10m, farmers carry 2x20 / 2x12.5kg, step-up bodyweight 45 to 50cm.

sessions.name: Friday, threshold
sessions.intent: Same pace as last Friday, two minutes longer per block. Minute ten should look identical to minute one. Do not upgrade the effort.
sessions.note: Zones: 1 runner + 15m shuttle, 2 runner + wall ball, 3 rower + farmers carry, 4 bike + bench step-up, 5 ski + sled. Machine legs go 3 min to 4 min; the floor leg stays at 2 min so local fatigue never forces a stop. Accessory is dropped this week to protect the clock.

sessions.intent: Same five rounds, same pace, rest drops to two minutes. It should feel about a point harder by round three. That is the progression, not a mistake.
sessions.note: Two minutes is true rest, so the layout is compressed to under 15m between stations and the call is "moving at ninety seconds". Round two is a trap: do not go faster because you feel good.

sessions.note: Zones: 1 runner + 15m shuttle, 2 runner + wall ball, 3 rower + farmers carry, 4 bike + bench step-up, 5 ski + sled. With a two minute rest the two pods crossing from zone 5 to zone 1 move first on the whistle, through the coned rig bays. Hardest week of the block: next week is shorter and faster.

sessions.intent: Shorter and faster. Rounds one to five are a nine out of ten. Round six is everything you have, on your round one machine, and it goes in the log.

sessions.name: Friday, upper threshold
sessions.intent: Last session of the block. Blocks drop back to eight minutes and the pace goes up five to eight seconds per five hundred. Two or three words now, not four.
sessions.note: Floor loads go up one increment: wall ball 9/6kg, carry 2x24 / 2x16kg, step-up with 1x10kg, sled at 13 to 16s per length. The no-walking rule still applies, so if the heavier load stops you, put it back down mid-block.

sessions.name: Friday
sessions.note: Both team mates run 800m at the same time. Lunge and Sled shared between them in any fashion.
sessions.intent: In pairs

sessions.name: Anchor
sessions.intent: Sustainable strength endurance. A pace test disguised as a grind. Four to six rounds per pair is the target window.
sessions.blurbOverride: Strength endurance under a long clock. Five stations, partner alternating, sled and carries throughout. The goal is a pace you can hold for 22 minutes, not a sprint you survive.
sessions.appDescription:
ANCHOR

In pairs, 22 min AMRAP:
20/16 cal Ski
20 Wall Balls
25m Sled Push
20m DB Farmers Carry
20 DB Walking Lunge

One works, one rests. Swap each station.

Signature session. This one comes back in
week 4, so remember your score.
sessions.note:
Five stations around the room. Stagger the ten pairs: pairs 1-2 start at ski, 3-4 wall balls, 5-6 sled, 7-8 farmers, 9-10 lunge. They rotate in written order from wherever they start.
The stagger keeps two pairs at the sled. If a third arrives early they hold at the carry and take the lane when it frees. Say this in the brief or you lose two minutes to a queue.
Load check: under three rounds means too heavy, over seven means too light. Correct it live, not next week.
The one cue: unbroken wall balls in round four is the goal, not round one.
Tell them this returns on 21 September. Scores on the board, get them to photograph it.
Capacity: OK at 20. Stagger is what keeps sled at 2 lanes.

timedBlocks.label: WU
timedBlocks.note: Warm-up. 3 min easy machine, then 2 rounds of the dynamic set, finishing with light wall balls and DB deadlifts.

timedBlocks.label: PREP
timedBlocks.note: Station prep. Sled 2 x 12.5m building to working load. 5 wall balls at working ball. 5 DB front rack reverse lunge each side. Confirm partners and starting stations before the clock.

timedBlocks.label: A
timedBlocks.note: Primer. 10 min EMOM, alternating.

slots.note: Odd minutes · Open: 10 reps, lighter DB · Foundation: 8 reps, light DB or bodyweight

slots.name: DB Romanian Deadlift
slots.note: Even minutes · Open: 10 reps, lighter DB · Foundation: 8 reps, light DB

slots.name: Deadhang
slots.note: Even minutes, time remaining after A2 · Open: Max hold · Foundation: Bar support hold or band-assisted

timedBlocks.label: B
timedBlocks.note: Anchor. 22 min AMRAP in pairs. One works, one rests. Swap at the end of each station. Complete in order. Score: rounds and reps per pair. Goes on the board.

slots.name: Wall Ball
slots.note: Open: 20 reps @ 6/4kg · Foundation: 15 reps @ 4kg to lower target

slots.name: Sled Push
slots.note: Open: 25m moderate · Foundation: 25m light or sled only

timedBlocks.label: FINISH
timedBlocks.note: Cooldown. 400m easy walk or row, then couch stretch, lat stretch and forearm release.

sessions.name: The Triangle
sessions.intent: Threshold, continuous and honest. The cleanest teaching session of the block. Spend the brief on pacing, not movement.
sessions.blurbOverride: Three rounds of row, ski and run at 500m each. Rotating start so the machines never clash. Round three should land within 45 seconds of round one.
sessions.appDescription:
THE TRIANGLE

3 rounds for time:
500m Row
500m Ski
500m Run

Rotating start, continuous clock.
Score is total time.

Signature session. This one comes back in
week 4, so remember your time.
sessions.note:
Exact equipment fit. Seven rowers, seven skis, six to ten runners. Split into three equal groups by headcount, not ability.
They move as individuals, not as a group. Some will lap others, which is fine, machines free up naturally.
Stimulus is 7 to 8 out of 10. Round 3 within 45 seconds of round 1. If it is 90 seconds or more slower they went out too hard. Say it in the brief and again in the debrief.
Returns 23 September. Times on the board.
Capacity: Exact fit at 20. 7 + 7 + 6 = 20.

timedBlocks.label: WU
timedBlocks.note: Warm-up. 5 min progressive on your starting machine, then the dynamic set and a 200m run build.

slots.name: Starting Machine Progressive
slots.note: 2 min easy, 2 min moderate, 1 min at target pace

timedBlocks.label: PREP
timedBlocks.note: Machine prep. Damper and monitor setup. Write target 500m splits on the board per machine. State the plan out loud: a 500m pace you can hold nine times, not once.

slots.name: Target Split Board
slots.note: Write 500m targets for row, ski and run

timedBlocks.label: A
timedBlocks.note: The Triangle. 3 rounds for time. Cap 30 min. Three groups, each starting on a different station. Rotate as an individual on completion. Clock runs continuously. Score: total time for all 4,500m. Cap 30 min.

timedBlocks.label: FINISH
timedBlocks.note: Cooldown. 5 min easy spin with nasal breathing, then hamstrings, calves and hip flexors.

sessions.name: Half Rox
sessions.intent: The race, halved. Four stations, five runs, 2.5km of compromised running. Most will take 26 to 32 minutes.
sessions.blurbOverride: A half race simulation run solo. Alternating 500m runs and stations so the room self-balances. The teaching point is run one: if it is faster than run five, the session was paced wrong regardless of total time.
sessions.appDescription:
HALF ROX

For time:
500m Run / 500m Ski
500m Run / 50 Wall Balls
500m Run / 500m Row
500m Run / 100m DB Farmers Carry
500m Run

Half a race. Pace run 1 like you mean to
finish run 5.

Signature session. This one comes back in
week 4.
sessions.note:
Self-balancing. At any moment roughly half the room is running and half is at a station, which lands under the ten runner ceiling as long as you stagger the start. Do not send twenty people at once.
No sled, deliberately. Two lanes cannot serve twenty athletes moving through a fixed sequence. Sled lives on Monday.
The teaching point is run 1. Anyone whose run 1 is faster than their run 5 has failed the session regardless of total time.
Call splits at the start of every run so they can hear the drift.
Returns 25 September. Times on the board.
Capacity: OK at 20 with staggered start. Do not mass start.

timedBlocks.label: WU
timedBlocks.note: Warm-up. 400m easy run, the dynamic set, then light wall balls and a 250m ski build.

timedBlocks.label: PREP
timedBlocks.note: Course walk. Walk the course and show every transition. Assign start waves. Give a target run pace and tell them run 1 should feel too easy. Say it twice.

slots.name: Wave Assignment
slots.note: Two waves 90s apart, or stagger individuals every 30s

slots.name: Pace Target
slots.note: Write target run pace on the board

timedBlocks.label: A
timedBlocks.note: Half Rox. For time. Cap 33 min. Two waves 90 seconds apart, or stagger individuals every 30 seconds. Score: total time. Cap 33 min.

timedBlocks.label: FINISH
timedBlocks.note: Cooldown. Walk it out, quads and calves, then a two minute debrief on run splits.

sessions.name: Tether
sessions.intent: Work under a clock you do not control. Your partner's run is your rest, so their pacing decides your session. Most pairs finish in 18 to 22 minutes.
sessions.blurbOverride: Same strength endurance job as week 1, completely new game. One partner runs 400m while the other accumulates reps. The sled is first in, first served, and leaving it until last is how pairs run out of time.
sessions.appDescription:
TETHER

In pairs, 23 min cap:
60 Wall Balls
40 DB Walking Lunge
40 Alt DB Snatch
20 Burpee Broad Jumps
50m Sled Push

One partner runs 400m while the other
works. Swap on return. Any order.
Sled is first in, first served.
sessions.note:
The run is what makes this legal. Ten pairs, one runner each, exactly ten air runners. Never let both partners leave the floor.
Sled is first in, first served. Tell them they can bank the other stations while they wait, and that any pair leaving the sled until last will run out of time. That is the game, not an accident.
The pacing lesson sits on the runner, not the worker. A partner who sprints the 400m gives their teammate less rest and takes less work off the list. Point that out to a pair doing it.
Watch the snatch. Fatigued DB snatch becomes a rounded-back swing. Cut the load before you cut the reps.
Capacity: Exact fit at 20. 10 pairs = 10 runners.

timedBlocks.label: WU
timedBlocks.note: Warm-up. 3 min easy bike or row, then 2 rounds of the dynamic set, finishing with light DB snatch and wall balls.

timedBlocks.label: PREP
timedBlocks.note: Movement prep. DB snatch setup and turnover. Burpee broad jump landing mechanics, soft knees and a controlled stick. Sled load and lane brief.

timedBlocks.label: A
timedBlocks.note: Primer. 10 min EMOM, alternating.

slots.name: DB Front Rack Squat
slots.note: Odd minutes · Open: 8 reps lighter · Foundation: 6 reps light or goblet

slots.name: Heavy Farmers Carry
slots.note: Even minutes · Open: 20m moderate · Foundation: 20m light

slots.name: Deadhang
slots.note: Even minutes, time remaining · Open: Max hold · Foundation: Bar support hold

timedBlocks.label: B
timedBlocks.note: Tether. 23 min cap, in pairs. Partner A runs 400m while Partner B works. Swap when the runner returns. Complete the list in any order. Score: time, or reps remaining at the cap. Sled capped at 2 pairs, take when free.

slots.name: Run (Air Runner)
slots.note: Continuous partner rotation, not a listed task · Open: 300m · Foundation: 200m

slots.name: Burpee Broad Jump
slots.note: Open: 20 · Foundation: 15 step back and step forward

timedBlocks.label: FINISH
timedBlocks.note: Cooldown. 3 min easy, then hip flexors, thoracic opener and forearms.

sessions.name: Rotations
sessions.intent: Short intervals and top end, the exact opposite of week 1's continuous grind. Same track, same aerobic job, completely different feel on the floor.
sessions.blurbOverride: Three seven-minute blocks of 30 seconds hard and 30 seconds easy, rotating row to ski to run. Score is total metres, so sandbagging block one to win block three gains nothing.
sessions.appDescription:
ROTATIONS

3 x 7 min blocks:
7 x 30s hard / 30s easy
Block 1 Row, Block 2 Ski, Block 3 Run

Score is total metres.

Then 8 min AMRAP:
10 Wall Balls
10 Alt DB Snatch
10 Burpee Broad Jumps
sessions.note:
Exact fit. Three groups: seven on row, seven on ski, six on run. Rotation happens once every seven minutes so there is no traffic.
The 30s easy is not a stop. Keep the handle moving and the belt turning or the interval loses its point. This is the most common failure in this session.
Metres in block 3 should be within 5% of block 1. Tell them the score is the sum.
Finisher is whole room at once, no bottleneck. Set the broad jumps running one direction so nobody collides.
Capacity: Exact fit at 20. Finisher is whole-room, no bottleneck.

timedBlocks.label: WU
timedBlocks.note: Warm-up. 5 min progressive on your first machine, the dynamic set, then 3 x 15s builds to sprint pace.

slots.name: Starting Machine Progressive
slots.note: 2 min easy, 2 min moderate, 1 min at target pace

timedBlocks.label: PREP
timedBlocks.note: Target setting. Explain the 30/30. Set a metre target for the first effort so they have something concrete to chase, and write it on the board.

slots.name: Interval Brief
slots.note: Explain 30s hard / 30s easy, easy is not a stop

timedBlocks.label: A
timedBlocks.note: Rotations. 3 blocks of 7 min. Within each block: 7 x 30s hard / 30s easy. 90 seconds to rotate between blocks. Three groups each starting on a different machine. Score: total metres across all three blocks.

slots.name: Row
slots.note: Block 1 · Open: 7 x 25s hard / 35s easy · Foundation: 7 x 20s hard / 40s easy

slots.name: Ski Erg
slots.note: Block 2 · Open: 7 x 25s hard / 35s easy · Foundation: 7 x 20s hard / 40s easy

slots.name: Run (Air Runner)
slots.note: Block 3 · Open: 7 x 25s hard / 35s easy · Foundation: 7 x 20s hard / 40s easy

timedBlocks.label: B
timedBlocks.note: Finisher. 8 min AMRAP. Whole room at once.

slots.name: Burpee Broad Jump
slots.note: Open: 10 · Foundation: 10 step back and step forward

timedBlocks.label: FINISH
timedBlocks.note: Cooldown. 5 min easy on any machine, then full lower body and shoulders.

sessions.name: Pyramid
sessions.intent: A descending pyramid raced solo. It gets shorter as they get more tired. Say that out loud at the start, it changes how the room feels at minute twenty.
sessions.blurbOverride: Four rounds, each shorter than the last, alternating run, machine and wall balls so the room self-balances. Individual effort with a staggered start. Pairs live on Saturday, not here.
sessions.appDescription:
PYRAMID

34 min cap:

800m Run / 500m Row or Ski / 40 Wall Balls
600m Run / 400m Row or Ski / 30 Wall Balls
400m Run / 300m Row or Ski / 20 Wall Balls
200m Run / 200m Row or Ski / 10 Wall Balls

Every round is shorter than the last.
Staggered start, race your own.
sessions.note:
Stagger the start every 30 seconds. The alternating run and station structure then keeps runners under ten without you managing it.
'Row or ski' is deliberate. Fourteen erg stations for twenty athletes, and the stagger means they never all arrive at once. Do not lock them to one machine.
Most will finish all four rounds inside the cap. Anyone still in round 3 at 28 minutes should cut to the 200m round to finish with the group.
The descending structure is the engagement. Announce it, then repeat it at the start of round 3.
No pairs and no sled here. Saturday owns partner work, Monday owns the sled.
Capacity: OK at 20 with staggered start. Individual, no pairs.

timedBlocks.label: WU
timedBlocks.note: Warm-up. 400m easy run, the dynamic set, light wall balls and a 250m row build.

timedBlocks.label: PREP
timedBlocks.note: Machine and pace. Allocate machines, set a pacing target for the opening 800m, and assign stagger order.

timedBlocks.label: A
timedBlocks.note: Pyramid. 34 min cap. Individual, staggered start every 30 seconds. Score: total time, or rounds and reps at the cap.

timedBlocks.label: FINISH
timedBlocks.note: Cooldown. Easy walk, then hamstrings, calves and shoulders.

sessions.name: The Five
sessions.intent: Peak week. Heaviest day of the block. Fixed work, fixed rotation, nowhere to hide. Round two scores will drop and that is correct.
sessions.blurbOverride: Five stations, four athletes each, two and a half minutes on and thirty seconds to rotate, twice through. Twenty-five minutes of actual working time at the heaviest loads of the block.
sessions.appDescription:
THE FIVE

5 stations, 2:30 on / 30s rotate, 2 rounds:

Sled Push
DB Farmers Carry
Wall Balls
DB Walking Lunge
Air Runner

Heaviest day of the block.
Every station gets a score.
sessions.note:
Five stations x four athletes is exactly twenty. With sixteen, run the same five stations with three each and the same clock. Do not cut stations.
Sled: four athletes, two lanes. They pair up inside the station and alternate 12.5m. Each gets roughly half the work time, which is correct for a heavy sled and is why this station is written as shuttles.
Runner station is four of ten machines. No conflict with anything else in the room.
Loads should feel genuinely hard by round 2. Tell them round 2 will be lower than round 1 so they do not chase round 1 and blow up at station 3.
Capacity: Exact fit at 20. 5 stations x 4. Sled pairs alternate within station.

timedBlocks.label: WU
timedBlocks.note: Warm-up. 3 min easy machine, then 2 rounds of the dynamic set, finishing with goblet squats and light wall balls.

timedBlocks.label: PREP
timedBlocks.note: Load stations. Load every station to working weight before the clock. Build the sled in two passes and set the DBs out at each station rather than mid-rotation.

slots.name: Station Loading
slots.note: DBs set at each station before the clock

timedBlocks.label: A
timedBlocks.note: The Five. 5 stations, 4 athletes per station. 2:30 work / 30s rotate. 2 full rounds. 25 min of working time. Score every station separately, then total.

slots.name: Sled Push
slots.note: 4 athletes, 2 lanes, pair up and alternate · Open: Moderate load · Foundation: Light or sled only

slots.name: DB Front Rack Walking Lunge
slots.note: Open: 2x12-16kg · Foundation: Bodyweight or single DB

slots.name: Run (Air Runner)
slots.note: Open: Max metres · Foundation: Steady pace, not max

timedBlocks.label: FINISH
timedBlocks.note: Cooldown. Full lower body stretch, unhurried. Quads, adductors, calves, glutes. They will need all eight minutes.

sessions.name: Threshold
sessions.intent: Peak week. Long intervals at threshold, the hardest engine day of the block. Three minutes is long enough that they have to pace it, which is the point.
sessions.blurbOverride: Five rounds of three minutes hard and ninety seconds easy, changing machine every round. Rounds four and five are athlete's choice with no repeats, which self-balances the room and hands members a decision.
sessions.appDescription:
THRESHOLD

5 x 3 min hard / 90s easy:
R1 Row, R2 Ski, R3 Run
R4 and R5 your choice, no repeats

Score is total metres. Hold them flat.

Then 10 min EMOM:
Odd: 12 Wall Balls
Even: 12 DB Box Step-Overs
sessions.note:
Rounds 4 and 5 are athlete's choice on purpose. A fixed run round for all twenty would need twenty runners and you have ten. Choice with a no-repeat rule self-balances the room and hands members a small decision, which they like.
Rounds 1 to 3 are a clean three-group rotation. Call the machine at the start of each 90 second rest so nobody is still deciding when the clock starts.
Flat metres across five rounds is the whole test. Anyone whose round 1 is their best round paced it wrong.
Finisher is whole room, no bottleneck. Benches for the step-overs, DBs held at the side rather than front rack.
Capacity: OK at 20. Choice rounds prevent 20-on-10-runners.

sessions.name: The Long One
sessions.intent: Peak week and the longest continuous piece of the block. Raced solo. This is the closest a weekday session gets to a full race.
sessions.blurbOverride: Four kilometres of running broken by four stations, alternating so the room self-balances. The hardest single effort in Block 01 and the best preparation for a real race distance.
sessions.appDescription:
THE LONG ONE

For time, 35 min cap:
1000m Run
50 Wall Balls
750m Row
40 DB Walking Lunge
750m Run
100m DB Farmers Carry
750m Ski
30 Wall Balls
500m Run

Longest session of the block.
Staggered start. Race your own.
sessions.note:
Stagger every 30 seconds. The run and station alternation then keeps runners under ten on its own, same mechanism as Half Rox.
This is the longest session in the block and members should know that before they book. Say it in the app description and again in the brief.
Cap is 35 min and most will need 30 to 34. Anyone past 32 minutes and still on the ski should skip to the final 500m run so the class finishes together.
Pacing cue for the day: the opening 1000m is the trap. It should be slower than their Half Rox 500m pace, not faster.
No pairs, no sled. Saturday owns partner work, Monday owns the sled.
Capacity: OK at 20 with staggered start. Individual, no pairs.

timedBlocks.note: Warm-up. 400m easy run, the dynamic set, light wall balls and a 250m ski build.

timedBlocks.label: PREP
timedBlocks.note: Course and pace. Walk the transitions. Assign stagger order. Give an opening 1000m pace target and tell them it should feel conservative.

timedBlocks.label: A
timedBlocks.note: The Long One. For time. Cap 35 min. Individual, staggered start every 30 seconds. Score: total time. Cap 35 min.

timedBlocks.label: FINISH
timedBlocks.note: Cooldown. Walk it out properly, then quads, calves, hamstrings and shoulders. Announce that the signature sessions return next week.

sessions.name: Anchor (retest)
sessions.intent: Repeat of 31 August. Same distances, same loads, same stagger, same partners wherever possible. Primer cut from 10 min to 6 min so the retest is fresh.
sessions.blurbOverride: The week 1 signature returns unchanged. Lower primer volume this week, which is the deload. Put the week 1 scores on the board before anyone walks in.
sessions.appDescription:
ANCHOR // RETEST

In pairs, 22 min AMRAP:
20/16 cal Ski
20 Wall Balls
25m Sled Push
20m DB Farmers Carry
20 DB Walking Lunge

Same session, same loads as week 1.
Bring your score. Let's see it move.
sessions.note:
Same partner as week 1. If someone's partner is missing, pair them with a similar output and write it on the board next to the score so the comparison stays honest.
Same loads. Not heavier. Members will want to go up. Tell them no, and that the next block is where the load moves.
Expect 10 to 20% more rounds. Anyone going backwards has usually gone out too hard because they remembered the finish, not the pace.
Be honest in the debrief: a good chunk of a four week improvement is learning to pace the session, not fitness. Tell them the real answer comes when these return in late November.
Do not add the accessory volume back. The reduced primer is the deload.
Capacity: OK at 20. Same setup as week 1.

THE TRIANGLE // RETEST

3 rounds for time:
500m Row
500m Ski
500m Run

Same session as week 1.
Bring your time.
sessions.note:
Same starting machine as week 1. Starting on run instead of row changes the time enough to spoil the comparison. Write the week 1 groups on the board.
Read them their round splits from week 1 in the brief. The coaching point is that round 3 should be closer to round 1 this time, not just that the total is faster.
This is the cleanest data of the block. It is the number to quote in the block debrief and in any content you make about the program.
No finisher this week. That is the deload, do not add one.

sessions.note:
Same wave and same start order as week 1. Consistency matters more than convenience here.
Compare run 1 against run 5, not just the total. A member whose total is unchanged but whose split drift halved has made the improvement that actually matters for a race.
Close the block. Five minutes at the end: what moved, what is coming in Block 02, and any race dates worth putting on the wall.
This is where the next four weeks of attendance gets sold. Do not let the class drift out the door.

sessions.name: Game Day: the rotation
sessions.intent: First Game Day of the block. Teams of three, one working at a time, everybody moving all morning. Set the tone: loud, social, nobody left standing on their own. This is not a test day.
sessions.note: Five teams of three or four. Each team starts on a different station and rotates on the whistle, so no station is ever doubled up. Score is total metres, calories and reps added together. Call the swaps for the first two stations, then let the teams run themselves.

sessions.name: Game Day: the rotation, longer
sessions.intent: Same shape as last week so the room already knows the rules, one minute longer at each station. The point is a slightly bigger engine, not a harder session: hold the same pace for longer.
sessions.note: Same five teams if you can, so they can beat last week. Sleds are three lanes only, so the sled station runs as a queue: one team pushes while the next team resets the lane.

lines.text: Sled push and drag, max lengths
One athlete per lane, swap at the end of each length
Farmers carry the length of the floor between turns

sessions.name: Game Day: you go, I go
sessions.intent: Pairs instead of teams, so nobody can hide in a group of three and everybody gets a partner they might not know. Steady aerobic effort with a hard finish.
sessions.note: Pairs. One works, one rests, straight swaps. Pair people across the room rather than letting friends pair up, that is half the point of the morning. Scale the run to 400m on the air runner if the legs are cooked from the week.

lines.text: Alternate whole rounds with your partner
Alternate whole rounds with your partner
Alternate whole rounds with your partner

sessions.name: Game Day: the chipper
sessions.intent: One long list, one team, share it any way you like. This is the community session at its best: the fast members carry more, the newer members are still part of finishing it, and everybody stays until the last team is done.
sessions.note: Teams of four. Split every line however the team wants, only one person working per movement at a time. If a team finishes early they go and make noise for the team still working. Everyone stays on the floor until the last rep.

circuit.heading: For time, as a team of four

lines.text: Whatever is left when the clock stops is the score
